incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT P1 — embeddings-api errors >15% for account Gimbal Systems (acct:gimbal-prod). Auto-paging on-call. Link: https://alerts.redwood/ALR-9231

oncall-luis: On call. grabbing logs and metrics, will update in ~2m.

sara-eng: Noted retries spike at proxy layer for gimbal-prod. Could be cache churn after last deploy. @oncall-luis happy to assist with rollout rollback.

oncall-luis: Rolling back embedsvc@2026-03-17 as a first step for gimbal-iso pool. Triggering restart of 6 pods now.

eng-infra-bot: Deploy rollback initiated — service=embedsvc, tag=2026-03-17 -> rollback, initiated_by=luis, expected_duration=3m.

marta-cs: Heads-up: Gimbal CSM Anne pinged priority channel asking for customer note. Can someone draft a short tailored impact message?

kevin-pm: Keep it short and non-technical. Include: what happened, affected scope (accounts/regions), mitigation in progress, and next update ETA. Avoid internal jargon. :+1:

marta-cs: Drafting now — posting below for quick review:

```
Subject: Incident affecting embeddings for Gimbal Systems (Mar 17)

Hi Anne / Gimbal team,

We’re investigating increased errors and latency for the embeddings endpoint that affected requests from your production workspace (acct:gimbal-prod). Our engineers have rolled back a recent deployment and are applying a mitigation; we expect normal traffic to resume shortly.

Impact: Intermittent 5xx errors and elevated latency for embeddings calls originating from gimbal-prod during the window of 17:02–17:14 UTC.

What we’re doing: rollback + cache policy fix; monitoring closely.

We’ll send a follow-up with a root-cause summary and timeline.

Support
Redwood Inference
```

sara-eng: Rollback reduced 5xx rate to baseline for ~30% of traffic. Still seeing p95 latency ~3.2s for the account. Will run cache policy change as canary on 5 hosts.

oncall-luis: Applying kv-cache policy hotfix to canary hosts now — will monitor error rate and p95.

eng-infra-bot: Canary deploy started on hosts: g-embed-canary-[01..05]. Health checks streaming to /canary-dashboard.

incident-bot: Status page draft update queued: 
```
We are investigating increased errors impacting embeddings for a subset of customers, including Gimbal Systems. Mitigation in progress.
```
Approve to publish?

kevin-pm: :thumbsup: publish.

marta-cs: Once we confirm improvement I'll send the customer note from support@redwood-inference.com.

sara-eng: Canary looks good — errors back to normal on 5/5 canary hosts, rolling to remaining pool now. p95 dropping toward baseline.

oncall-luis: Full roll complete. All checks green. Root cause initial triage: cache eviction regression introduced in the 2026-03-17 embedsvc rollout. Will capture full RCA.

marta-cs: Sending tailored customer note now (sent to anne@gimbal.com, ops@gimbal.com). Copy of sent message:

```
Hi Anne,

We resolved an issue that caused intermittent errors and higher latency on the embeddings endpoint for Gimbal Systems. The problem was detected at 17:02 UTC and mitigated by 17:14 UTC via rollback and cache-policy adjustments.

Impact: Intermittent failed embedding requests and slow responses during that window.

Next steps: We’ll publish a post-incident report with root cause and actions to prevent recurrence.

Regards,
Support — Redwood Inference
```

kevin-pm: I’ll update the public status to "resolved" and add a short summary + link to incoming postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident timeline recorded. Severity downgraded (P1 -> P2) then marked resolved. Postmortem ticket created: PMT-4629.

marta-cs: Thanks everyone — will follow up with customer once RCA is ready.

oncall-luis: Closing the loop here. If anyone needs the rollback artifacts or logs, I pushed them to #sre-artifacts/embedsvc/1819994321.

sara-eng: Nice work. :relieved:

kevin-pm: Good response. We'll review in the next blameless postmortem.
